name: Hugging Face
summary: Platform for machine learning models, datasets and demos.

flows.title: Create a model repository
steps: To create a new repository, visit huggingface.co/new.
Specify the owner of the repository: yourself, or any of the organizations you are affiliated with.
Enter the model's name. This is also the name of the repository, and the Hub uses it in the repository's address.
Specify whether the model is public or private.
Specify the license. The License field may be left blank for now.
After the repository is created, the Hub prompts you to create a Model Card.
